PRICING_GUARD.name: Pricing guard
PRICING_GUARD.desc: Checks discounts and margins on quotations.

ORDER_CONFIRMATION.name: Order confirmation
ORDER_CONFIRMATION.desc: Checks credit, price locks, and limits before confirming sales orders.

PURCHASE_APPROVAL.name: Purchase approval
PURCHASE_APPROVAL.desc: Controls approval thresholds and supplier rules on purchase orders.

CREDIT.name: Credit
CREDIT.desc: Evaluates customer credit exposure and blocks.

INVENTORY_NEGATIVE.name: Negative inventory
INVENTORY_NEGATIVE.desc: Controls when stock is allowed to go below zero.

INVENTORY_RESERVATION.name: Inventory reservation
INVENTORY_RESERVATION.desc: Controls stock reservation priorities and channel limits.

INVENTORY_OVER_RECEIPT.name: Over-receipt
INVENTORY_OVER_RECEIPT.desc: Controls tolerance when receiving more stock than ordered.
